title: Sable and the Current
author: Ines Sterling
blurb: Yara Okafor, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
